title: Conditions raised by zutoml — zutoml-conditions
text: Every error zutoml raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zutoml_error.

title: Conditions raised by zutoml — zutoml-conditions
text: zutoml_invalid_argument argument unusable, value written TOML given, list partial names string valid UTF-8. Carries arg, argument fault. zutoml_parse_error document TOML. Carries line column (1-based, characters), offset (0-based, bytes) kind, name rule broken, "bad_escape" "table_redefined". zutoml_unrepresentable document valid TOML holds value R : string containing U+0000, string longer R string, integer beyond 2^53 big_integers = "error". zutoml_unsupported_type R value TOML form, function, raw vector matrix. Carries path, key path value, .b[3].c. zutoml_na_error NA NULL value na = "error". Carries path. zutoml_limit_error limit reached. subclasses zutoml_size_limit, zutoml_depth_limit, zutoml_item_limit zutoml_string_limit name one. Carries limit, argument's name, "max_depth", limit_value. zutoml_io_error file connection read written.

title: zutoml: Read and Write 'TOML' Documents — zutoml-package
text: Parses 'TOML' (Tom's Obvious Minimal Language) version 1.0 documents ordinary R values writes R values 'TOML'. Every 'TOML' type maps one R type, including four date time types, strings never reinterpreted. Invalid documents refused line column fault, configurable size, depth item limits. Output deterministic readable. Conformance checked 'toml-test' suite (https://github.com/toml-lang/toml-test) directions. parser writer written C system library required.
